Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc

Klasse NpcType

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.NpcType
public final class NpcType extends Object
What an NPC looks like to the client: a fake player, or one of Minecraft's living entity types.

This is a value object over EntityType rather than an enum of its own. An enum would have to be extended by hand for every mob Mojang adds, and would silently lack whatever the running server supports; delegating means a new mob type works the moment the server knows about it, which is exactly the extensibility the version adapters already provide.

Only living entity types are accepted. NPCs carry equipment, animations and nametags, all of which are properties of living entities; a boat or a dropped item would need an entirely different rendering path and is out of scope for this type.

Instances are immutable and safe to share across threads.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • of

      public static NpcType of(org.bukkit.entity.EntityType entityType)
      Returns the NPC type for a Bukkit entity type.
      Parameter:
      entityType - the entity type to render as
      Gibt zurück:
      the NPC type, PLAYER for EntityType.PLAYER
      Löst aus:

    • fromId

      public static NpcType fromId(String id)
      Parses the serialised form produced by id().

      Matching is case insensitive so that hand-written configuration files do not have to shout.

      Parameter:
      id - the type id, for example PLAYER or villager
      Gibt zurück:
      the NPC type
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if id is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if no living entity type has that id

    • entityType

      public org.bukkit.entity.EntityType entityType()
      Returns the Bukkit entity type this NPC is rendered as.
      Gibt zurück:
      the entity type, EntityType.PLAYER for player NPCs

    • isPlayer

      public boolean isPlayer()
      Returns whether this is a player NPC.

      Player NPCs are the only ones with skins, tab list entries and a profile, and they are the only ones whose spawn requires a player info update before the spawn packet.

      Gibt zurück:
      true for PLAYER
